title: feat(bem): Add BEM-styling to the Stats widget
body: Updated the Stats widget to use `ais-stats` BEM classes. Exact same rendering as before, but open the way to theme creation.

comments.body:
A quick note, you can add "BREAKING CHANGE: ..." to the commit message so that it will be picked by the changelog generator.

Even if we are in an alpha state it's always good to add the breaking changes because people already started using the project internally. So we can link them to the changelog when in need.
You're right, I've added the breaking change note (even if this should not break much :) )
Indeed the change is less breaking than the previous PR where we removed `cssClass` in favor of `cssClasses`.
